candidate_structure.information_flow: The first call receives every common input and emits only analysis. The final call consumes that analysis, directly receives task, anchor_policy, anchor_contract, and task_constraints, remains cut off from candidate_hypothesis and loop_structure, and emits one complete policy.
candidate_structure.name: Selective Inherited-Artifact Reentry
candidate_structure.organization: two-call sequential lineage with one restored inherited-policy visibility edge

calls.objective: Reconcile inherited and counter-generative claims against normative obligations, preserve material conflicts and distinctions, and emit only analysis.

Consume synthesize_cut_counter_sources, reconcile its evidence with visible normative inputs and the directly visible inherited policy artifact, and emit one complete policy without reacquiring the other cut sources.

mode_certificate.scope_boundary: Only the anchor_policy-to-final-call visibility edge changes from the current champion topology.
mode_certificate.why_not_repeat_role_fission: The lineage retains the same two calls and authorities; no producer, reviewer, gate, or terminal subrole is added or split.

qualitative_hypothesis.causal_change: Restore direct terminal visibility of anchor_policy while retaining the existing cuts on candidate_hypothesis and loop_structure.
qualitative_hypothesis.expected_effect: Artifact-level continuity should reduce materialization failures without reopening terminal access to counter-generative sources.
qualitative_hypothesis.falsifier: all-valid matched majority and strict-median contract, with no score
qualitative_hypothesis.observed_bottleneck: The terminal authority must reconstruct a complete policy from an analysis-only handoff without direct artifact-level continuity from the inherited policy.

structural_mutation.after: The final call additionally receives anchor_policy; all other edges, cuts, roles, and authority remain unchanged.
structural_mutation.before: The final call receives the upstream analysis and normative inputs but cannot directly see anchor_policy.
structural_mutation.factor: selective inherited-policy visibility restoration on the terminal edge
structural_mutation.why_structural: This adds one concrete visibility edge carrying a complete inherited artifact into terminal policy authority.
